commanders.name: Chief of the Wilds
commanders.oracleText:
Menace
Whenever another Wolf you control enters, put two +1/+1 counters on Chief of the Wilds.
If a triggered ability of another Wolf or battle you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.
commanders.reason: Its printed ability keys off wolf tribal, which the pool supports.
commanders.plan: Flood the board with Wolves, then let every trigger happen twice.

commanders.name: Aatchik, Emerald Radian
commanders.oracleText:
When Aatchik enters, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token for each artifact and/or creature card in your graveyard.
Whenever another Insect you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Aatchik. Each opponent loses 1 life.
commanders.reason: Its printed ability keys off graveyard value, which the pool supports.
commanders.plan: Recur the best threat every turn.
